I Love You Rosa
I Love You Rosa( translit. Ani Ohev Otach Rosa) is a 1972 Israeli film directed by Moshé Mizrahi. It was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. It was also entered into the 1972 Cannes Film Festival.
